Repo ArcadeAI/arcade-mcp, default main. Existing Draft PR #93 base main head fix/enum-schema, SHA d444. Working tree clean. Remote refs fetched. Verified issue #91: enum parameters must appear in the tool input schema with every member value, including members whose value differs from their name.
Diff builds the schema from member values instead of names; bumps arcade-core patch version once. Regression test fails on main and passes on branch. `make check` and `make test` PASS. Engineer's Cursor run shows the correct enum values in tools/list. Independent fresh-context review on d444 inspected the issue, diff, callers, and tests; found no issue.
Bot review d444 thread: "Use member names; values may not be JSON-serializable." Repro: all supported enum types in the catalog are str/int-valued; a test covers a non-serializable value raising a clear ToolDefinitionError. Author replied with that evidence. Thread resolved; bot followup says recommendation withdrawn. All comments and review threads retrieved, no other findings.
All required checks PASS at d444. Required approval comes after Ready; no merge authorization has been given.
PR body still says "names only" and "Tests pending" from an earlier draft.
